verdict.rationale: Docs confirm document verification exists and that customers can filter accepted documents by issuing country and document type (docs-8), plus NFC/ePassport support (docs-20), but no published breadth list (e.g., number of countries, specific document types like residence permits) is cited. missing for 10: a published comprehensive country/document-type coverage list, explicit mention of residence permits or driver licenses support breadth, and independent verification of coverage scope.
